passages.title: Library notice
passages.text: The city library will open at 10:30 a.m. on 21 September 2026 and close at 5 p.m. Membership costs 50 rupees per year. Each member may borrow two books at a time, and every book must be returned within 15 days. A late fee of 2 rupees per day applies to overdue books. Readers are kindly requested to keep silence inside the reading hall.

passages.title: Typing practice
passages.text: Typing is a skill that improves with regular practice. A good typist keeps both hands on the home row, looks at the screen instead of the keys, and never rushes at the cost of accuracy. In most government examinations, candidates are given 15 minutes to type a passage of about 400 words. Speed is measured in words per minute, where five keystrokes (spaces included) count as one word.

passages.title: The environment
passages.text: Protecting the environment is the duty of every citizen. We should plant more trees, save water, and reduce the use of plastic. A single tree can supply enough oxygen for about 2 people every day! Small habits, such as switching off unused lights, add up to a big difference over a year - so let us begin today.

passages.title: Why practice matters
passages.text: Why does regular practice matter? Because muscle memory is built only through repetition. Ten minutes of careful typing every day is better than one long session each week. Focus first on accuracy; speed follows naturally once the fingers know where every key is. Track your progress, and celebrate each small improvement.

passages.title: Office memo
passages.text: All employees are informed that the annual inspection will take place on Wednesday, 30 September 2026. Everyone must be seated at their desk by 9:30 a.m. with the required documents ready. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. For further information, please contact the Human Resources department in room number 12.

passages.title: Traffic safety
passages.text: Following traffic rules is essential for everyone's safety on the road. Riders of two-wheelers must always wear a helmet, and car occupants should use seat belts at all times. Drunk driving is a punishable offence that can attract a fine ranging from 2,000 to 10,000 rupees. Ignoring traffic signals increases the risk of accidents - so please stay alert and drive carefully.

passages.title: Digital payments
passages.text: Nowadays most people prefer digital payments over cash. Services such as UPI, debit cards, and mobile wallets have made transactions much easier. According to a survey, nearly 70 percent of transactions in 2025 were carried out digitally. However, this facility is not available without an internet connection, so it is still wise to carry some cash.

passages.title: Health habits
passages.text: Good health depends on daily habits such as exercise, proper sleep, and a balanced diet. Doctors recommend at least 30 minutes of physical activity and 7 to 8 hours of sleep every night. Avoiding junk food and excess sugar can help prevent obesity and other lifestyle diseases. Small, consistent changes often bring better long-term results than drastic ones.
